nearestExisting.description: Identify composite record keys with real local MiniLM column-role inference. nearestExisting.description: Link required task inputs to deliverables with real local MiniLM inference. Review directed prerequisites, reject cycles, propagate held inputs and export a complete JSON/CSV/Markdown execution plan with honest dependency-only timing bounds without content uploads.

nearestExisting.name: Retention Desk
nearestExisting.description: Plan record retention reviews with real local MiniLM policy matching. Review policy links, protect holds, calculate calendar dates and export a complete JSON/CSV ledger without deleting files or uploading content.
